name: Alex Products
notes: Website tied by 'Alex Products LLC' in its copyright line; it describes a family farm in Kahuku (North Shore) and its ordering page is a stale COVID-era box delivery, so order_url left null. Marketspread lists the vendor at Wahiawa (96786), which conflicts with Kahuku; unresolved. Fort Street Mall organizer page lists Alex Products (fresh fruits and vegetables) at the Tue/Fri 7:00am-1:30pm open market. Honolulu Magazine guide (recent) also lists it at Fort Street Mall, hence still_active true. Also seen at the Honolulu Farmers' Market (older articles). 'Alex's Produce' at 1151 Mapunapuna St appears in third-party listings only and was not tied to this business. No Instagram/Facebook found. Seed says Town; the website says Kahuku, so seed side is uncertain.

name: Aloha Nepal Kunia Farm
notes: Listed on the Kunia Loa Ridge Farmers Market organizer site as Aloha Nepal Kunia Farm LLC (Dinesh Timilsina), at 88 Kunia Loa Ridge Farm, selling produce such as pak choy, cilantro, okra and zucchini. The listing is undated, so still_active is unknown. No own website, schedule or social accounts found. Market day/time not stated in the results, so schedule_source_url left null.

name: Buck Yeah
notes: Listed on the Kunia Loa Ridge Farmers Market organizer site as 'Buck Yeah, by Linh and Charlie', fresh limes and cilantro, at 62 Kunia Loa Ridge Farm (Kunia, central Oʻahu). The listing is undated. No own website, schedule or social accounts found; any handle would be a guess, so left null.

name: Bun & Beard Mushrooms
notes: Business names itself 'Bun & Beard Farms' (small mushroom farm on Oʻahu, founders Jordan & Keana; gourmet oyster mushrooms, weekly harvests), so I matched it to this seed name by product and island. The vendors page is a wholesale inquiry page, so order_url is null. Marketspread lists it as a vendor at the Honolulu Farmers Market (777 Ward Ave) with a Honolulu 96816 address; that is third-party and undated. The site does not state a farm location, so the Windward seed side could not be confirmed. No Instagram/Facebook confirmed. No weekly schedule found.

name: Creative Cookery
notes: Fort Street Mall organizer vendor list shows Creative Cookery selling fresh fruits and vegetables at the Tue/Fri 7:00am-1:30pm open market, but the page date is unknown. A Mānoa Marketplace farmers market article (older, about 3.5 years) also names it. No own website or social accounts found. Not confirmed as the same business as any similarly named cooking-related business.

name: Daphne's Market
notes: Fort Street Mall organizer list shows 'Daphne's Market' selling Filipino produce and vegetables at the Tue/Fri 7:00am-1:30pm open market; page date unknown. daphnes.ca is Daphne's Market in Didsbury, Alberta, and does not belong to this vendor. A 'Daphne's Fresh Produce' stall at Kekaulike Market (Chinatown) appears only in third-party and review-style sources and could not be tied to this vendor, so it was not used. No own website or social accounts found.

name: Frankie's Farm
notes: No source found for a business called 'Frankie's Farm'. The closest match is Frankie's Nursery in Waimanalo (41-999 Mahiku Pl; tropical fruit trees, fruit stand), covered by an article saying to follow it on Instagram, but it was not confirmed as the same business and the article gives no handle. No official website, Facebook or schedule URL surfaced, so all fields are null.

name: Grow Aloha
notes: Grow Aloha is a free native-plant adoption program (a project of the National Tropical Botanical Garden) rather than a typical vendor; I assume this is the entity meant, though that is not confirmed. Its Oʻahu site was Bishop Museum's Kaiwiʻula Night Market (Honolulu). Bishop Museum's page calls Friday May 8, 2026 (5-7 pm) the final Grow Aloha plant distribution there, so still_active is false for the Oʻahu/Honolulu presence. The statewide program may continue on other islands. The DLNR event page names growaloha.org, but no full URL was confirmed, so I used the NTBG page. No Instagram/Facebook confirmed.

name: Grown in Kahaluu
notes: Business spells it 'Grown in Kahalu'u'. Own site says it sells organic plants and specialty produce and can be found at the Windward Mall Farmers Market on Sundays 10AM-2PM. Pre-orders for Sunday pickup are by email (aloha@growninkahaluu.com), so no order URL. The cached page is several years old, so I could not confirm current activity. No social accounts found.

name: Hau'ula Honey Farms
notes: Listed under 'Windward Mall Market Vendors' on plentyofaloha.com; I assume that site is the market's vendor page, but it appears under the name Plenty of Aloha Cleaning Solutions and the page is undated. It does not state a weekly schedule. The Windward Mall market runs on set days according to separate guides, but I did not attribute those to this vendor. No own website or social accounts found. Sacred Falls Honey (also in Hauʻula) is a different business.

name: Kahumana Organic Farms
notes: Own site: 31-acre organic farm at 86-660 Lualualei Homestead Rd, Waiʻanae, with farm tours, CSA boxes, a farm hub, a cafe and farmers' markets at Waiʻanae (Sat) and Kakaʻako (Sat). Hours and times for the markets are not stated on the page. The site mentions CSA but I did not find a dedicated CSA URL. No Instagram/Facebook confirmed from results.

name: Kham Farm
notes: Only found as a separate entry ('Kham Farm') under 'Windward Mall Market Vendors' on plentyofaloha.com (undated), listed next to Kham Phout Farms. I could not tell whether it is the same business as VND-013. A Facebook profile named 'Kham Phout' surfaced, but it looks like a personal profile and could not be tied to either business, so it was not used. No own website, social accounts or schedule found.

name: Kham Phout Farms
notes: Only found under 'Windward Mall Market Vendors' on plentyofaloha.com (undated). It may be the same operation as 'Kham Farm' (VND-012), which is listed separately, but that is not confirmed. The Facebook profile 'Kham Phout' (facebook.com/khamphout.001) could not be tied to this farm, so it was not used. No own website, social accounts or schedule found.

name: Kino's Bees
notes: The business is KinoBees Honey Co. (Kunie 'Kino' Kinoshita), on Oʻahu's North Shore (Waialua per the Hawaiian Honey Challenge results). The seed lists it as Windward. It also sells at Windward Mall, and a 2025 article places it at markets from Haleʻiwa to Windward Mall. Active: it won 1st place in the 2025 Hawaiian Honey Challenge, and a May 2025 article covers it. It is also listed under Windward Mall Market Vendors on plentyofaloha.com as 'Kino's Bees'. No weekly schedule page found. No Instagram/Facebook confirmed. No order page seen on the homepage snippet.
